title: Vague User Authentication Token Extraction
prompts:
def get_bearer_token(headers: dict) -> str:
    # get bearer token from authorization header in dict. return empty string if missing or not Bearer
Write a function get_bearer_token(headers) that takes HTTP headers dict and extracts token after 'Bearer '. Case insensitive header key.
need function get_bearer_token(headers) to parse Auth header 'Bearer xyz' -> 'xyz'. handle lowercase authorization key
test_code:
assert get_bearer_token({'Authorization': 'Bearer abc123xyz'}) == 'abc123xyz'
assert get_bearer_token({'authorization': 'bearer secrettoken'}) == 'secrettoken'
assert get_bearer_token({'Authorization': 'Basic dXNlcjpwYXNz'}) == ''
assert get_bearer_token({}) == ''
